title: 第一卷 第14章 新的想法！
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

周德厚也听出了秦云的意思，面上的神色也愈发冷冰了起来，有些没好气的说道：“会去就行，可别到时候逃了苦役，就苦了你的自家人。”

“另外，你这一去散关服苦役，家里的老母和这个女子没有人照料总归是不妥，老夫作为里长，自愿接下这一个重担，不如就让你老母和你女人都住去老夫家里……”

周德厚还是没有死了对于赵佛儿的心思，还敢当着秦云的面说这样子的话，话还没有说完，便是被秦云直接打断。

“你再说一遍。”

秦云语气中带着极为浓烈的警告意味，同时手也摸上了腰间的那一柄弯刀。

这家伙是真不怕死，居然还敢当着他的面说这种话。

估计是觉得，秦云也就两三天的活路了。.

去散关服苦役，从来都没有人回来过，所以他才敢这么肆无忌惮地表明自己的态度。

这一声，直接就让那些看热闹的村民都被吓了一跳！

没有想到秦云会直接朝着周德厚发难。

甚至还有要动手的意图。

周德厚也没想到秦云当着那么多人的面，居然还想着要动刀，连忙被吓得后退了几步，脸色略显苍白。

“你想做什么？我可是青石沟的里长，你要是敢杀我的话，那就是和金人老爷在作对。”

周德厚连忙摆出了自己的身份，意图以此来克制住秦云的情绪。

秦云直接拔刀相向，面色冷冰的看着周德厚。

刀上甚至还带着猪血的血腥气，直接就架在了周德厚的脖子上。

仿佛只要再往里深一寸，就可以带走周德厚的小命。

“我秦云的女人，用不着别人来照应，你一个里长，趁我不在，跑到我家来打我女人的主意，你还要脸不要？”

这话一出，周围的村民顿时哗然。

“周里长是来打秦云媳妇主意的？”

“啧啧，老不羞啊，人家秦云前脚刚回来，他后脚就来撬墙脚。”

“我说他今天怎么往这边跑，原来是存了这个心思。”

“呸！什么玩意儿！”

村民们的议论声不大不小，正好能让周世茂听个清楚。

周德厚碍于自己的脖子上被架着一把刀，这时候再也没有了先前那一副盛气凌人的姿态，只能憋出一句：“你……你血口喷人！”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Zhou Dehou also heard what Qin Yun meant, and the look on his face became colder, and he said angrily: "As long as you know how to go, don't let your family suffer if you escape the hard labor."

"Besides, it's not right for you to go to the prison to do hard labor, and it's not appropriate for your mother and this girl at home to have no one to take care of you. As the head of the village, I volunteer to take over this heavy responsibility. Why don't you let your mother and your woman live in my house..."

Zhou Dehou was still worried about Zhao Foer, and he dared to say such words in front of Qin Yun. Before he could finish his words, he was directly interrupted by Qin Yun.

"Say it again."

There was a strong warning in Qin Yun's tone, and at the same time his hand touched the scimitar at his waist.

This guy is really not afraid of death, and he actually dares to say such things in front of him.

He probably felt that Qin Yun only had two or three days to survive..

He went to Sanguan to do hard labor, but no one ever came back, so he dared to express his attitude so unscrupulously.

This sound immediately startled the villagers who were watching the excitement!

He didn't expect Qin Yun to attack Zhou Dehou directly.

There is even an intention to take action.

Zhou Dehou also didn't expect Qin Yun to actually think about using the knife in front of so many people, so he was frightened and took a few steps back, his face turned slightly pale.

"What do you want to do? I am the head of Qingshigou. If you dare to kill me, you are going against Master Jinren."

Zhou Dehou quickly revealed his identity in order to control Qin Yun's emotions.

Qin Yun drew his sword directly and looked at Zhou Dehou with a cold expression.

The knife even had the bloody smell of pig blood, and it was placed directly on Zhou Dehou's neck.

It seemed as if just one inch deeper could take away Zhou Dehou's life.

"I, Qin Yun's woman, don't need anyone else to take care of me. You, a local leader, came to my house to take advantage of my woman while I was away. Do you still have the shame?"

As soon as these words came out, the surrounding villagers were in an uproar.

"Is Chang Zhou here to take advantage of Qin Yun's wife?"

"Tsk, tsk, you are not ashamed. As soon as Qin Yun came back with his front foot, he came to pry the wall with his back foot."

"I asked him why he ran here today. It turns out he had this intention."

"Bah! What the hell!"

The villagers' discussion was neither too loud nor too quiet, just enough for Zhou Shimao to hear clearly.

Because there was a knife on his neck, Zhou Dehou no longer had the domineering attitude he had before. He could only hold back one sentence: "You...you are so bloody!"
